posts.headline:
DevOps *Myth*
vs *Reality*

versus.label: MYTH
versus.text: You need to be an expert programmer to start learning DevOps.

versus.label: REALITY
versus.text: Start with the fundamentals and build your skills in *Linux, Git, scripting, cloud* and *automation*.
versus.note: You don't need to know everything to get started.

posts.cta_note: Start with the basics. Build skills that matter.
